summary: Iter-1 cold codegen for chemical_detector (run-8, condition B): 17 Java files under chemdetector/ implementing two controllers (GasAnalysis, Movement), Vehicle/Actuator surfaces, Telemetry sensor service, events, datamodel, constants. All 81 requirement IDs traced in result_codegen.json.

issues.title: Final states rerouted to live modes (Done / Found self-loop)
issues.detail: CD-GA-Beh6 and CD-MV-Beh9 specify transitions to final state j1. Per CLAUDE.md, the theory-generated controller must not contain a Final state (unprovable deadlock-freedom residual). GasAnalysis therefore transitions GasDetected->Done (live mode, event self-loop on gas) while still sending stop; Movement transitions into Found and stays there (event self-loop on stop) while still emitting flag and halting via move(0, Front).

issues.title: Chem and Intensity realised as primitives
issues.detail: CD-DM4 Chem is an int (nat) compared by ==; CD-DM5 Intensity is a double (real) ordered by goreq. Dedicated wrapper types would force method-chain expressions that the extraction rules ban.

issues.title: odometer realised as sensor method, not input event
issues.detail: CD-Evt3 describes odometer as an event, but its uses (CD-MV-FR4 entry 'odometer ? d0', CD-MV-Beh16 action 'odometer ? d1') are receive-AS-ACTION communications, which the pipeline's action statement set does not include. Realised as zero-arg Telemetry.odometer() read in the corresponding transition actions (d0 = odometer(); d1 = odometer()).

issues.title: Vehicle operations as plain methods, no operation classes
issues.detail: CD-OP1..4 are Vehicle-provided motion operations (move, randomWalk, shortRandomWalk, changeDirection), not controller-side computation groups, so no compute()-style operation classes were generated; they are methods on Vehicle invoked from transition actions.

issues.title: Guard totality encoded as predicate + its negation
issues.detail: Two-way autonomous splits (Analysis on sts, GasDetected on ins>=thr, AvoidingAgain on makingProgress) use one named predicate and its literal negation (b / !b) so the extracted guard cover is trivially total for the provers, instead of two independently-named predicates.

issues.title: analysis() target-chemical criterion
issues.detail: A reading indicates the target chemical iff c == targetChem AND i > 0.0. The spec does not define the per-sensor detection criterion.

issues.title: angle() index-to-direction mapping
issues.detail: 1->Front, 2->Right, 3->Back, 4->Left, out-of-range->Front. The spec says position maps to direction but gives no table.

issues.title: Constant values
issues.detail: thr=1.0, lv=1.0, evadeTime=1, stuckPeriod=1, stuckDist=1.0, outPeriod=1, targetChem=1. Spec says configured at startup; values chosen inside the FDR4 {0..1} instantiation ranges.

issues.title: Safe defaults for empty readings
issues.detail: intensity([]) = 0.0, location([]) = Front (via angle(0)), analysis([]) = noGas, per the sensor-layer safe-default rule; spec preconditions assume non-empty input.

issues.title: goreq used directly in guards vs inlined comparison
issues.detail: The threshold guard is written ins >= thr (plain comparison) rather than goreq(ins, thr) to keep the extracted guard a simple comparison; goreq exists on Telemetry and is used inside intensity()/location() per CD-Fn4.

issues.title: Waiting 'during randomWalk()' encoded as head-of-mode-block call
issues.detail: CD-MV-FR1 specifies during action randomWalk(); encoded as vehicle.randomWalk() at the head of the Waiting mode block, the pattern the extraction lifts as the state action.

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (compile through vacuity) and iterate on feedback.
